title.narrative: Growing female-driven social businesses for Zero Hunger in East Africa

description.narrative: Overall objective: Food security and economic conditions in Uganda and Kenya will be improved in the long term.Project Objective: Access to and use of services and products have improved through sustainably strengthened, women-owned businesses in the project regions in Uganda and Kenya in one of the following sectors: food, climate-friendly agriculture, digitalisation, WASH and vocational training

Strengthening businesses & female entrepreneurship in climate-smart food production, agriculture, climate change, nutrition, WASH, digitalization, skills development where by (1) 40 businesses are mentored & capacity build, made investment ready (2) 10 businesses receive small loans to scale. (3) Support network for female entrepreneurs created for joint learning.

The direct target group consists of 16,200 people (at least 60% women), 40 women-led social enterprises with about 5 employees each (200 people) in Uganda and Kenya. 16,000 members of underserved communities who are users and customers and/or suppliers (at least 50% women) of the strengthened social enterprises. The indirect target group is 72,900 household members of the direct target group (employees of social enterprises, customers, users and suppliers) in the target communities in Uganda and Kenya.
